title: Perfect pillow for my bad back and a good price.
text: Perfect pillow for my bad back and a good price.. Perfect for relieving back pain. Straps are adjustable to fit over chair so it won't slip. Cancer claimed one of my lungs and was removed from between ribs in my back. I've had terrible back ever since. I finally have relief. Lite weight, too.
